name: Kargo GitOps Promotion Self-Hosted
free_limit: Open-source Apache-2.0 Kubernetes-native GitOps promotion controller; self-hosted stages, warehouses and promotion workflows without vendor-imposed software usage quotas.
watch_out: Requires your own Kubernetes cluster and deployment infrastructure; cluster, image registry and CI provider charges are separate. Akuity's managed enterprise offering is distinct from the free self-hosted project.
